trial_court: Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Shopian, OWP No. 62/2016
case_name: Muzaffar Ahmad Thoker Vs. Shaheena Akhter & Another
facts_of_case: The respondents filed a petition under Section 488 Cr. PC for interim maintenance. The petitioner assailed the order in revision. Both parties entered into an amicable settlement and agreed to remarry. The respondent wife filed applications seeking execution of the compromise.

legal_principles.principle: A daughter has a statutory right to be maintained by the father, regardless of whether the mother has a right to be maintained.
legal_principles.held: The Supreme Court in the case of 'Savitri v. Govind Singh', reported in 'AIR 1986 SC 984', ordained that even an application supported by an affidavit will be sufficient to seek such relief.

legal_principles.principle: The grant of interim maintenance is a relief against destitution, and the aim and object of the grant is to prevent vagrancy and provide the wife and child a breathing space to live.
legal_principles.held: The aim and object of the grant of interim maintenance is to prevent vagrancy and to provide the wife and child a breathing spur to live.

legal_principles.principle: A person receiving a handsome salary cannot evade their responsibility to maintain their child and the wife.
legal_principles.held: The petitioner being an able bodied person receiving a handsome salary cannot evade his responsibility to maintain his child and the wife.

legal_principles.principle: The freedom of religion under the Constitution is absolute, except to the extent that it affects public order, health, morality and other provisions of Part III dealing with Fundamental Rights.
legal_principles.held: Per Hon'ble Mr Justice Kurian Joseph (Majority view): To freely profess, practice and propagate religion of one's choice is a Fundamental Right guaranteed under the Indian Constitution. That is subject only to the following- (1) public order, (2) health, (3) morality and (4) other provisions of Part III dealing with Fundamental Rights.
cited_cases: Shayara Bano & Ors v. Union of India & Ors., (2017) 4 JKLT 1 (SC)

outcome.final_order: The final court order recorded the statements of the parties, sent down the file to the Court of the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, who disposed of the petition Under section 488 Cr. PC as settled.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for interim maintenance
